purpose: Local training-only mechanism diagnostic, not an optimizer sweep or new final evaluation
checkpoint_rationale: Available same-seed/same-partition early step2, intermediate step5 and final step20; no search over validation-best models
useful_checkpoint_definition: At least one rare class has positive predicted AND actual FedAvg CE change above tolerance; projection improves that change; all protected actual losses do not increase above tolerance; retain at least 10 percent of original step norm
gate: At least two useful checkpoints and safety at every checkpoint, otherwise stop; no automatic continuation
gradients: All assigned training examples, eval-mode full-network 8-logit CE; no dropout. Class count weighted sums. All8 gradients for diagnosis, only3 needed for hypothetical method
actual_loss_scope: Same training population, no generalization claim; no validation or test arrays opened
local_training: Historical reset-Adam full epoch and original loss denominator, same RNG order and Flower aggregation; CPU diagnostic not a CUDA bitwise continuation
projection: Closest full-network parameter displacement subject to three class-gradient dot products <=0; no tuned scaling, line search, softened constraints or repeated corrected rounds
